talk.sound: On the bourse they say the house's paper is as good as gold.
talk.steady: The bourse thinks it a steady house that pays when it says.
talk.stretched: There is talk on the bourse that the house is buying more than it can carry.
talk.doubtful: A broker whispers that the house's bills have been refused twice this season.

remarks.sound: My partner says the house is sound to its cellars: little debt, honest books, money put by.
remarks.steady: My partner finds the books in order. Nothing to fear, nothing to boast of.
remarks.stretched: My partner thinks the profits are dressed up and the warehouse half pledged already.
remarks.doubtful: My partner would not lend them a thaler. The books hide more than they show.
